newsitem.title: USA: Mitsubishi Electric unit forms new company.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Electric unit forms new company.

text.p: Mitsubishi Electric Corp said Friday its Mitsubishi Electric America division will merge three units to form Mitsubishi Electric Automation Inc.

The three businesses that will make up the company include Mitsubishi Electric Industrial Controls, the Industrial Automation division and the Automated Sewing Application Products unit, Mitsubishi said.
The new entity will make automation products for several industries at manufacturing and training facilities in Vernon Hills, Illinois.
Mitsubishi Electric makes controllers, PC-based control systems, AC drives and motor packages for several industries.
